notes.title: [INFO] Multiplayer
notes.content:
We have been hinting at the introduction of multiplayer and co-op modes to the game for a while now. These innovations will be able to make the gameplay more exciting by adding the ability to interact with other players. Below is a roadmap of future multiplayer and co-op features based on the current situation and assumptions about the direction of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42277900/9d941fef989887a25ccbf983f8c59a1462f5dce6.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Stage 1: Co-op mode[/list]
[i]Expected date: October 20, 2024.[/i]

The first stage includes the introduction of a co-op mode, where players will be able to unite to carry out missions against artificial intelligence.
In co-op mode, players will be able to coordinate their actions, distribute roles and jointly control troops to achieve victory.
Key features:
Co-op missions for up to 4 players.
Co-operative tactical decisions on the map.
Unique co-op missions and scenarios.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42277900/835780beffd1fe52d1a6cca96013c22e712cbc3f.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Stage 2: Testing and implementation of PvP multiplayer[/list]
[i]Expected date: End of 2024.[/i]

At this stage, we plan to add multiplayer support, which will allow players to participate in battles against each other in real time. The game will become more dynamic due to PvP - battles on pre-created maps.
The main task will be server testing and optimization of the network code for stable operation of the game in conditions of many players.
Key features:
Battles up to 10 players on one map.
A variety of battle settings.
The ability to customize your own army and tactics before the battle.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42277900/15e965056ac6e68b574f28073830ca6545b3f818.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Stage 3: Global multiplayer campaigns[/list]
[i]Expected date: beginning - mid-2025.[/i]

At this stage, players will be given access to global multiplayer campaigns, which will combine elements of tactical battles with a global strategy. Players will be able to capture territories, create alliances and develop their factions.
The diplomacy system and trade between players will become an important element in this mode.
Key features:
A global map with several players.
Diplomacy, trade and alliances.
The player's influence on the political situation in the world.



The introduction of multiplayer and co-op in "Total Conflict: Resistance" will open up new horizons for players. Joint battles, competition with friends and strategic thinking in real time will allow you to immerse yourself in the game from a new side. Stay tuned and get ready for exciting battles!

[b]HINTS (Tactical battle):[/b]

[*]Press "Tab" to select all units. Use the "1"-"9" keys to select an individual squad.
[*]Press the "F1" key to send the selected units into battle.
[*]To send the selected units to any position, right-click (use a binocular for convenience, "B" key).
[*]To deploy a squad in any direction, use the middle mouse button.
[*]Press the "F2" key to stop (hold on) the selected squads.
[*]You can send selected units to their original position by pressing the "F3" key.
[*]You can "possess" any selected squad by pressing the "H" key.
[*]You can switch to tactical mode by pressing the "M" key.
[*]To quickly land troops, select all units by pressing "Tab", press "J". Passengers will leave the transport.
[*]Use the "X", "C" and "Z" keys to change the body position of the soldiers. Standing infantry moves much faster than in "Crouch" and "Prone" modes.
[*]Use the "Shift" key while aiming.
[*]Use the "K" key to order the selected units to follow you
[*]To exit/enter a vehicle, pick up a other weapon, press the "F" key.
[*]To change the shooting mode of an weapon (single-burst-automatic mode, etc.), press the "V" key.
[*]To change weapons in armored vehicles, press the "V" key (change the main weapon to a machine gun, etc.). Use "Shift" while aiming.
[*]Never use armored vehicles without infantry support.
[*]Try not to bring armored vehicles into the city.
[*]Organize the production of ammunition and grenade launchers in advance, this will significantly increase the combat effectiveness of the infantry.
